# Completion Report: Work Order 4 — Index Migration

All checklist items and API contract requirements for **Work Order 4 (Index Migration)** have been completed.

## Changes Summary

### 1. Schema Migration (`internal/core/index/index.go`)
- Preserved existing tables: `episodes_fts`, `entities`, `entity_relations`, and v1 claim tables (`claims`, `anchors`, `relations`, `conditions`).
- Added v2 tables and indexes in [`initSchema()`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.FwL3SOqfUg/repo/internal/core/index/index.go#L50):
  - `entries` table
  - `entries_fts` (FTS5 virtual table with `content=entries, content_rowid=rowid` and insert/update/delete triggers)
  - `entry_anchors` table and `idx_entry_anchors_anchor` index
  - `error_patterns` table
  - `aliases` table and `idx_aliases_old_scope` unique index
  - `entry_history` table and associated indexes
- Defined [`ErrNotFound = errors.New("not found")`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.FwL3SOqfUg/repo/internal/core/index/index.go#L16).

- [`GetHistory(ctx context.Context, entryID string) ([]dossiers.Entry, error)`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.FwL3SOqfUg/repo/internal/core/index/history.go#L44)

### 7. Rebuild from Op Log (`internal/core/index/rebuild.go`)
- Added [`RebuildFromOpLog(ctx context.Context, opsReader *ops.Reader) error`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.FwL3SOqfUg/repo/internal/core/index/rebuild.go#L161):
  - Clears all v2 tables inside a write transaction
  - Projects dossiers using `dossiers.NewProjector(opsReader).Project(ctx)`
  - Upserts entries and anchors
  - Populates error patterns for failure-signature entries
  - Populates history for retired / superseded entries
  - Builds and stores aliases from `config.BuildAliasMap`
- Retained the existing `Rebuild` function for v1 claims.

### 8. Verification & Tests (`internal/core/index/index_test.go`)
Added test suite covering:
- Round-trip `UpsertEntry` and `GetEntry`, updates, `ErrNotFound`, and `DeleteEntry`
- `ListEntriesByScope`
- FTS5 `SearchEntries`
- `LookupByAnchor` and `LookupByAnchorExact`
- `InsertErrorPattern` and `LookupErrorPatterns`
- `UpsertAlias` and `ResolveAlias` (chain and cycle resolution)
- `InsertHistory`, `GetHistory`, and `QueryHistoryByScope`
- Full end-to-end `RebuildFromOpLog` with op log creation and projection
